sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) documents unauthorized credit card fraud identified on customer account C12265. On 2016-12-03 06:04:26, flagged transaction 3509359 for $125.08 was detected via online channel with an elevated risk score of 0.52. Graph analytics and multi-hop link expansion revealed that the transaction was associated with device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080', which was identified across 255 additional cardholder accounts (C00094-K3, C00328-K1, C00375-K1). The cardholder, when contacted for transaction validation, confirmed they did not authorize the transactions and remained in possession of their physical card. The activity exhibits characteristics consistent with undocumented, where compromised credentials or card data were systematically exploited. Total cumulative fraudulent exposure across identified affected transactions (3509359) totals $125.08. The financial institution has taken immediate mitigating actions by blocking card C12265-K2 for reissue, opening internal case HHG-020 in graph memory, and placing all connected card accounts under continuous surveillance per Bank Policy R2, R6, and regulatory guidelines.

stop_reason: Multi-hop graph link analysis identified coordinated device sharing across multiple cards with anonymous proxy routing. Stop condition met per R6 and R9.
